changes.rationale: State accepts explicit LiveContext, AuthorityCatalog, and immutable DependencyActionCatalog inputs; receipts, generated views, status labels, telemetry, clocks, processes, and filesystem paths are not state inputs.
Typed findings preserve source, scope, dependency, cause, effect, authority, smallest declared repair, exact rerun, evidence invalidation, and bounded claim reductions.
The engine rejects stale policy identities and rejects an AuthorityCatalog whose context_id differs from the supplied LiveContext.

Each claim starts at an explicit maximum dimension set and derivation can only remove dimensions. Set inclusion provides lower, equal, higher, and incomparable relations without a false global total order.

Only actions for live repairs with satisfied dependencies and available capabilities are eligible. Blocked facts require authority-request routes; ties resolve by priority then lexical action ID; no findings yields a non-completion no-op.

Runtime fields accept only typed exposed-source classes plus nonempty source provenance; missing or invalid metadata remains explicit. Host goal observations are excluded from product authority identity and forcibly non-authoritative.
Inspect, diagnose, and next are deterministic ProductState-v1 projections serialized as isolated JSON bytes with no side effects.
